title: Retiring a follower must preserve its own row, rather than the requirement-indexed row.
details: Miller2008 section33, Theorem33.1 construction step2 at top of p76, visually checked. The endpoint g(s+1) is chosen to contain V(e,s), but the retired follower is x and step3 replaces V(x,s) by the initial segment through that endpoint. The containment test must be V(x,s) subset [0,g], otherwise previously enumerated elements of the retired row need not survive. Replacing e by x preserves stagewise monotonicity and the subsequent uniqueness verification. The corpus handoff also chooses fresh even endpoints to provide an explicitly infinite complement for the final filling enumeration.
